text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume family. That is—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A collective that shares and passes down 
wealth and knowledge. Their bond is far 
stronger than that of any ordinary human 
household.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Especially in Europe, there is a cultural 
tendency to place great importance on 
it... I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl was intently flipping 
through the books she had selected.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Europe... Even where I'm aiming to go, the 
concept of "house" identity remains 
strong. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"To break through this, learning is all 
the more essential! I'll even have to 
conduct direct interviews!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. When it comes to prestigious 
families representing the Umamusume world, 
which come to mind? Tell me a few, won't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To name a few typical examples for now...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—First, the Mejiro family. A prominent 
house among prominent houses, known for 
valuing the individuality of each 
Umamusume.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Next is the Satono Group. An 
up-and-coming family where Umamusume 
bearing the name Satono gather under the 
same philosophy."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro and Satono... Of course I know both 
of them. But...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to know more about the more 
closed-off families. Like those extreme 
'Tradition or Die!' kind of households.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like that would let me see its 
true essence better. Trainer, do you know 
of a house like that?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I was hesitating on whether to suggest 
them as a candidate. Interacting with them 
would likely be difficult, after all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, there was a house that matched 
the image Seeking the Pearl was looking 
for. And that was—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The "Splendid Clan"...?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's a strict, traditional family.

Yeah, it's a family with strict 
traditions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An ancient, noble bloodline renowned not 
only in racing, but in political and 
business circles. Their elegance and 
prestige are exceedingly high.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, its inner workings are rarely 
disclosed. And currently, the Umamusume 
enrolled at Tracen Academy are—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Daiichi Ruby." —That girl, huh.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We've never talked that deeply before. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Then let's take this chance to get 
everything out in the open. Let's go, 
Trainer.
choice_data_list:
Huh? But I feel like they'd turn me 
down...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No problem! It'll be fine! I've got a 
top-secret trump card up my sleeve!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A noble household guaranteed to turn away 
all callers. What is Seeking the Pearl's 
secret plan to breach it...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey, Ruby! Got a second to talk?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whenever Seeking the Pearl spots Daiichi 
Ruby, she approaches her without giving a 
second thought to her noble aura.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Could you tell me everything about your 
family, the Regal Clan?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It must be so interesting! I'm terribly 
curious! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A secret plan... It was an unexpected 
direct, straight-up negotiation with 
Daiichi Ruby... And in response, Daiichi 
Ruby...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Understood, Pearl-san.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I will tell you about our clan.
choice_data_list:
Are you sure you should share a secret 
like that?

Are you sure it's okay to share a secret 
like that?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: A secret...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
That is not it. It's simply that no 
Umamusume ever asked me directly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems that her noble aura has 
naturally led people to keep their 
distance at times.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I was invited into a 
private room. Once again, I took in her 
appearance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Daiichi Ruby. An ultra-high-class lady 
and an Umamusume belonging to the renowned 
'Noble Lineage.' The Noble Lineage refers 
to—”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A prestigious family known to everyone, 
not just in the Umamusume world, but 
across general society. Their influence 
reaches everywhere...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Furthermore, her grandmother was a famed 
Umamusume, and so was her mother. She has 
walked the royal road of the Triple 
Tiara..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is the glorious descendant of that 
very bloodline. She radiates an aura that 
practically draws you in, but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ruby, tell me. What is family to you? And 
what are you—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Are you just doing whatever the Glorious 
Family tells you?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In other words, are you obeying your 
family? Or rather, are you using your 
family to your own ends?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Who is the master, and who is the servant? 
That is what I wish to know.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Which is the master, and which is the 
servant? The answer to that is—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It is neither. For my house and I—are one 
and the same.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: One with... the house!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Be magnificent. Be supreme. Always 
radiate the greatest brilliance."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"From the moment I was born, I embraced 
that family motto, desired to live up to 
it, and have honed myself each and every 
day."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Dreams and missions, rights and duties—my 
clan and I are always one. We can never be 
separated.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Born as an Umamusume, as a member of this 
clan, all I must do is run aiming for the 
very top—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"That is what it means to be born into our 
family."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—Supreme is supreme. There can be no 
hierarchy or master-servant dynamic there.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "The supreme is supreme... So this is..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The "Splendid Clan"... The quintessential 
form of a prestigious Umamusume family...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's quite a formidable opponent, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On the way back from hearing the story, 
Seeking the Pearl looked visibly 
impatient."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't like she was following along 
reluctantly. They were bound by a shared 
destiny from birth...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Living seamlessly without any boundaries 
whatsoever... Well, I suppose that family 
is just an extreme case.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Backed by all that accumulated knowledge 
and wealth... It's only natural she's 
strong."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So this is the Umamusume "Family"... What 
I must stand against in Europe in the 
future. And...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That prematch, the showdown against the 
Mejiros, is right before our eyes...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even Seeking the Pearl wore a bitter 
expression, faced with the sheer scale of 
the challenge awaiting her in the upcoming 
Hanshin JF.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But...!! Even so!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Giving in is a big fat nothing! Don't you 
think so, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Bowing before the Umamusume Family, a 
gathering of the strong, means—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Accepting a world where only the winners 
keep winning! That's the one thing I will 
never allow! Absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I am the one who shows possibilities! I 
must prove to the entire world that anyone 
can achieve success. I swear it—!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In order to stand up against the Mejiro 
family for that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lost in thought, I passed by the front of 
the station. And right there was...

text_block_list.name: Volunteer
text_block_list.text:
Donations, please! Please consider 
donating for underprivileged children!

text_block_list.name: Volunteers
text_block_list.text: Please~!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Donations... Hehe, how wonderful. To have 
the mindset to extend a helping hand, even 
to complete strangers...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There lies genuine compassion. Even if 
they aren't family.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was just as she said. Bonds... are not 
something found only within an Umamusume's 
family.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though faint, it was something that 
existed between all people.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—I've seen something wonderful. Trainer, 
let's head back to Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"My home isn't there anymore. But... that 
doesn't mean all our bonds are gone, does 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even if I don't have family, I have a 
partner who shares the same dream.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe!" Exactly! Even if the first grain 
is tiny...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Layer by layer, growing larger and larger! 
That is—a pearl!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And thus began our days of special 
training. Though it was only two weeks, 
they were days spent pooling all our 
strength together.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, believe in me! Make me believe in 
you! And then—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's show them! Just how much potential 
lies within those who aren't part of the 
family!
